style.backgroundSystem: seamless white sweep #FFFFFF for packshots, mist-blue fields #DCE9F5 and one flat sky-blue split panel #7FAEDC, matte pale stone ledge #F0EEEB for routine pairing
style.iconSystem: hairline monoline glyphs in #1A1A1A, single stroke weight, crossed-slash variant for exclusion rows, no filled shapes and no lettering
style.lightingSystem: bright shadowless beauty softbox key from the front-left with a large fill card, cool high-key exposure, gentle contact shadows only, real skin texture kept
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean clinical-beauty ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, soft mist blue #DCE9F5, one flat sky-blue split panel #7FAEDC and charcoal hairlines #1A1A1A, with one product-matched pop accent reserved for markers; cool bright high-key tone; editorial serif display paired with modern geometric sans-serif, all in-image words left as blank placeholder rails; background system of seamless white sweep, mist-blue fields and a matte pale stone ledge #F0EEEB; lighting system of shadowless beauty softbox key from the front-left with a large fill, gentle contact shadows only, real skin texture kept; hairline monoline icon style at a single stroke weight; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no legible source copy.
noDrift: no legible source copy or invented letterforms
style.presentationRules: the pack keeps the same slight 3/4 hero angle and scale across packshots; the cloth always lifts from the flap toward the upper right; companion containers stay blank unlabeled props
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale stone ledge #F0EEEB and cool white board #F7F7F8, never glossy, never marbled with hard veining
style.typography: editorial serif display headline paired with modern geometric sans-serif labels and hairline rules; in this suite every word is stripped, so type appears only as blank placeholder rails
